sources.title: InsideEVs: Cheapest Tesla Model 3 With LFP Battery Impresses In Real-World Efficiency Test (Bjorn Nyland)
sources.notes: Reports Bjorn Nyland's test of a 2024 Model 3 RWD (LFP, 60.9 kWh gross). Linked video https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=n323lX3NUKI (timestamp not available). Published 2024-08-19.

sources.title: InsideEVs: Watch The New Tesla Model Y Take On The Old One In A 70-MPH Range Test (Out of Spec Reviews)
sources.notes: Out of Spec Reviews 70 mph test of the new (Juniper) Model Y Long Range AWD: 298 miles, both cars 'around 3.7 miles per kWh', 20-30 mph winds. Temperature and wheels not stated.

sources.title: InsideEVs: Volvo EX30 Twin Motor Performance Slightly Disappoints In Video Range Test (Bjorn Nyland)
sources.notes: Nyland test of EX30 Twin Motor Performance (69 kWh, 64 kWh usable per page), 20-inch wheels: 245 Wh/km (394 Wh/mile) at 75 mph, 57 F (14 C). Published 2024-04-18. Embedded YouTube ID L2aS-a81nIc (not confirmed as the test video).

consumption_highway_wh_per_km.notes: Test: 74.5 mph steady (page figure; ≈120 km/h is our conversion), ~19 C (66-67 F ambient), road conditions not stated, wheel size not stated, battery-side (Nyland's registered/car-display consumption; page does not say explicitly) | Bjorn Nyland, Norway, 2024 Model 3 RWD LFP 60.9 kWh gross (Highland, same generation, pack and RWD layout as our 60/57 kWh LFP Premium-I; test is a 2024 car, our variant is 2026). Page states 4.03 mi/kWh = 154 Wh/km (1000 / (4.03 x 1.609344) = 154). Same test at 56 mph (90 km/h): 5.49 mi/kWh = 114 Wh/km. Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=n323lX3NUKI, timestamp not known. Not the same market as ours (EU car), wheels unknown.

Test: 70 mph (113 km/h) steady, temperature not stated, 20-30 mph winds, wheel size not stated, battery-side (car display, Out of Spec Reviews method; page does not say explicitly) | Out of Spec Reviews, 2025 Model Y Long Range AWD (Juniper), 298 miles. Page says 'around 3.7 miles per kWh': one rounded figure given for both the old and new Long Range AWD together, and the page does not state the pack: 1000 / (3.7 x 1.609344) = 168 Wh/km. Other figures seen, not recorded: tparts.com relays 275 Wh/mi (171 Wh/km) for the same test; Bjorn Nyland Juniper Premium AWD 20.1 kWh/100 km at 120 km/h but only 12 C (autonomiacocheselectricos.es, no video link); AutoReview.nl LR AWD 20.04 kWh/100 km at 130 km/h, 19 C, 14.75 kWh/100 km at 100 km/h.

Test: 75 mph (120 km/h) steady, 14 C (57 F), 20-inch wheels, battery-side (Nyland's registered consumption; page does not say explicitly) | Bjorn Nyland, 2024 EX30 Twin Motor Performance, 69 kWh gross (page says 64 kWh usable; our data says 66 kWh usable, same 69 kWh gross NMC pack). Page states 245 Wh/km (394 Wh/mile, 2.5 mi/kWh), range 267 km. Cool weather, so a mild-weather figure would be lower. Video ID L2aS-a81nIc not confirmed.
